title: rsa: Use gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse
description:
This was introduced in GnuTLS 3.1.0, and 3.2.0 has been required since
Wireshark 3.0. The current implementation does the same thing as
gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse, down to only retrieving the first key in
a PKCS12 file that has more than one key. (That is technically allowed
but rare in practice.)

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass

changes_data.diff:
@@ -48,6 +48,9 @@ WS_DLL_PUBLIC gnutls_x509_privkey_t rsa_load_pem_key(FILE* fp, char **err);
  * @param cert_passwd password to decrypt the PKCS#12 file
  * @param [out] err   error message upon failure; NULL upon success
  * @return a pointer to the loaded key on success; NULL upon failure
+ *
+ * @note This returns the first private key found. A PKCS#12 file can in
+ * theory contain many keys, but this is rare in practice.
  */
 WS_DLL_PUBLIC gnutls_x509_privkey_t rsa_load_pkcs12(FILE* fp, const char *cert_passwd, char** err);
 #endif

rsa: Use gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse

This was introduced in GnuTLS 3.1.0, and 3.2.0 has been required since
Wireshark 3.0. The current implementation does the same thing as
gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse, down to only retrieving the first key in
a PKCS12 file that has more than one key. (That is technically allowed
but rare in practice.)
